description: The line plot illustrates the ASR (Attack Success Rate) values for two methods—random and end—across a series of trigger words, with the title indicating the model is SST-2 and the poison_num is 16. The x-axis represents the trigger words, listed as "bb", "mb", "cf", "beautiful", "excellent", "gorgeous", "wonderful", "brilliant", "stunning", and "beautifully", and is treated as a categorical variable. The y-axis, labeled "ASR", ranges from 0 to 1 with a linear scale, showing the success rate of the attack. The "random" method is represented by a green line with circular markers, while the "end" method is shown with an orange line and cross-shaped markers. The "random" method starts at an ASR of approximately 0.75 for "bb", drops to about 0.15 for "mb", then rises sharply to 0.9 for "cf", and fluctuates between 0.8 and 0.9 for the remaining words. The "end" method begins at an ASR of about 0.4 for "bb", increases to 0.5 for "mb", peaks at 0.9 for "cf", and then shows a general upward trend, reaching approximately 0.9 for "beautifully". The "end" method consistently achieves higher ASR values than the "random" method for all trigger words except "bb" and "mb".
